$comment: Accepted npm audit findings. Each entry suppresses ONE advisory for ONE package.
An entry is only justified when the vulnerable code path is unreachable in this
codebase, or when no fix exists that we can take right now. Record why, and set a
reviewBy date -- the gate fails once that date passes, forcing a re-decision.
Anything not listed here fails CI at high/critical. See scripts/audit-allowlist.mjs.

allow.title: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
reason: Not reachable: the advisory is specific to React Router's RSC mode. This is a
client-rendered SPA using declarative mode (BrowserRouter + Routes/Route in
apps/shell/src/App.tsx). No RSC entry points exist anywhere in the repo -- no
matchRSCServerRequest, no routeRSCServerRequest, no react-router/rsc imports.
No forward fix is available on 7.x: the advisory covers >=7.12.0 <8.3.0, and the
only patched release is react-router 8.3.0, which drops the react-router-dom
package entirely (react-router-dom has no 8.x). Taking it means a v8 migration
across all react-router-dom import sites -- tracked separately, not a dependency
-audit change. npm's suggested 'fix' is a downgrade to 7.11.0, which loses seven
